challenge.better_approach: Looked: reuse before build. Seals go only through reseal.reseal_all, tickets only through cast_ticket, questions only through cairn question, timing only through the scheduler; each piece adds one reader or one verb on those doors.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a dependent's seal evidence.reached names the components it reached (ticket 734b22d09f2e), so yellow and its dependents are readable from seals alone; and that the base shim's pulse runs on every device that has a list.
challenge.prior_art: Consulted the tickets corpus and the inspector: 50e0581737e8 (dependent-side yellow), the reseal ladder 4d9115eb04cd (rung 3 troubles, rung 4 decisions), 39eccfbc09aa (every sieve carries its why), ddc5cb6694d3 and eb27604ab267 (NOTRUN seals nothing). None does this piece; each is reused.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive: the bounds of 93fa3e3a6199 and its children also touch build_inspector, recorded as an ordering note, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: (1) a run with one red proof and one orphan of each kind casts exactly three tickets, each with its key in fixes and a sorted berth that exists. (2) the same run repeated casts nothing: each key is carried by the open ticket the first run cast. (3) a red whose proof is named in an open ticket's bounds.in casts nothing. (4) a cast refused by either door makes the run exit non-zero naming the refusal, and lands no partial ticket.
answers.from_idea: none, because outline 9.4.2.3.7 in press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt (Akien 2026-11-13, at commit 198f4ef24) is the design these tickets carry
answers.how: A module red_tickets.py in the tester: from a run's results and an orphan scan, build one dedup key per red (proof path + tooth) and per orphan (path); skip a key an open ticket carries in `fixes` or names in bounds.in; cast the rest through cast_ticket, each with its own /sorted firing through skills/sorted/door.py.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth) and outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 (reds don't get lost)
answers.what: Every tester run casts one ticket per new red and per orphaned file it sees, unless an open ticket already carries it, so reds don't get lost.

bullets.text: each test run tickets every new red and orphaned file it finds: one piece of outline 9.4.2.3.7, cast with its siblings
